profile.address: 3701 W. Burnham Street, Suite C, Milwaukee, WI 53215
profile.reading:
TierPoint operates a data center at 3701 W. Burnham Street, Suite C, in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, spanning more than 28,000 total square feet with more than 3,600 square feet of raised floor and 2,800 square feet of business-continuity seating. TierPoint markets the site with the phrase "state-of-the-art Tier III Milwaukee facility," though this appears to be descriptive marketing language rather than a confirmed formal Uptime Institute Tier III certification, since TierPoint's page does not cite a certificate number or third-party verification. The facility holds SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II certifications including HITRUST, and is HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GLBA, ITAR, and Data Privacy Framework compliant. TierPoint, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, was formed in 2010 and has grown to roughly 40 data centers across 20 US markets, primarily through a series of acquisitions including Xand in 2014, Windstream Hosted Solutions in 2015, and Cosentry in 2016. Xand's own documented facilities were concentrated in the New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania corridor rather than the Midwest, so this entry does not assert a Xand connection to the Milwaukee site without a source confirming it, and no opening year or acquisition history for this specific Milwaukee facility could be located this session because search-tool quota was exhausted. As is standard industry practice, tenant identities are not publicly disclosed. These gaps are recorded honestly rather than filled with unverified detail.

TierPoint has also grown through significant recent capital raises beyond its acquisition history: a 320 million dollar equity round in April 2020 led by Argo Infrastructure Partners, Wafra, and Macquarie Capital Principal Finance alongside existing investors, followed by Argo's 500 million dollar investment in February 2022 that made it TierPoint's largest single equity investor, and a further increase to Argo's ownership and capital commitment announced in December 2025. TierPoint has also completed several asset-backed securitizations in recent years, reflecting continued institutional confidence in the company's data center portfolio as it has expanded across its 20 US markets.

reading:
TierPoint is headquartered at 12444 Powerscourt Drive, Suite 450, in St. Louis, Missouri, and traces to 2010, when the company acquired its first data center in Dallas, Texas. Argo Infrastructure Partners increased its ownership stake and capital commitment to TierPoint in a transaction reported in December 2025, following an earlier round in which TierPoint closed $320 million in equity from a consortium of investors.

The company's own site describes a portfolio of 40 data center facilities across 20 US markets coast-to-coast, serving thousands of companies spanning small businesses to Fortune 500 enterprises across both public and private sectors.

The registry here tracks 3 TierPoint facilities across three states, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Texas, a small subset of the company's 20 named markets. TierPoint's origin in a 2010 Dallas acquisition and its continued Texas presence in this registry connect it to the same Dallas-Fort Worth corridor already carrying Stream, Digital Realty, and Aligned facilities recorded elsewhere in this registry.
